sources.title: CobaltRelay retry reference
sources.text: CobaltRelay is a fictional service in the synthetic operations workspace. This reference covers retry. CobaltRelay retries failed deliveries three times with a ten-second initial delay. This is a synthetic fixture, not a production service specification.

sources.title: DuneIndex embedding reference
sources.text: DuneIndex is a fictional service in the synthetic operations workspace. This reference covers embedding. DuneIndex uses 128-dimensional lexical hash vectors and requires reindexing when dimensions change. This is a synthetic fixture, not a production service specification.

sources.title: EmberQueue persistence reference
sources.text: EmberQueue is a fictional service in the synthetic operations workspace. This reference covers persistence. EmberQueue stores durable jobs in PostgreSQL; Redis only supplies wakeup notifications. This is a synthetic fixture, not a production service specification.

sources.title: FjordAPI readiness reference
sources.text: FjordAPI is a fictional service in the synthetic operations workspace. This reference covers readiness. FjordAPI readiness returns 503 when the database is unavailable; liveness still returns 200. This is a synthetic fixture, not a production service specification.

sources.title: GarnetWorker lease reference
sources.text: GarnetWorker is a fictional service in the synthetic operations workspace. This reference covers lease. GarnetWorker reserves each job for 240 seconds and stops its child after 180 seconds. This is a synthetic fixture, not a production service specification.

sources.title: HarborProxy exposure reference
sources.text: HarborProxy is a fictional service in the synthetic operations workspace. This reference covers exposure. HarborProxy listens on loopback port 8181 and has no public listener. This is a synthetic fixture, not a production service specification.

sources.title: IrisCollection privacy reference

sources.title: KestrelAlert alerting reference
sources.text: KestrelAlert is a fictional service in the synthetic operations workspace. This reference covers alerting. KestrelAlert fires after sixty seconds of database unavailability and clears after recovery. This is a synthetic fixture, not a production service specification.

sources.text: LumenUpload is a fictional service in the synthetic operations workspace. This reference covers uploads. LumenUpload accepts UTF-8 Markdown and text files up to two megabytes; scanned PDFs require OCR elsewhere. This is a synthetic fixture, not a production service specification.
